function initLogoCarousel() {
    const isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 768;
    const popups = document.querySelectorAll('.logo-carousel-hover__popup');
    const overlay = document.getElementById('popup-overlay');
    const section = document.querySelector('.logo-carousel-hover');
    
    // Remove all existing event listeners by replacing nodes
    document.querySelectorAll('.logo-carousel-hover__item').forEach(item => {
        const newItem = item.cloneNode(true);
        item.parentNode.replaceChild(newItem, item);
    });
    
    // Reset all popups
    popups.forEach(popup => {
        popup.style.display = 'none';
        popup.style.opacity = '0';
        popup.style.visibility = 'hidden';
    });

    normalizeLogoWidths(section);
    
        if (isMobile) {
            // Mobile behavior - click to toggle popup state
            document.querySelectorAll('.logo-carousel-hover__item').forEach((item, index) => {
                const popup = item.querySelector('.logo-carousel-hover__popup');
                const linkBox = item.querySelector('.logo-carousel-hover__box-link');
                const hiddenLink = item.querySelector('.logo-carousel-hover__hidden-link');

                item.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                    // If a link inside should be followed, let it bubble
                    if (e.target.closest('.logo-carousel-hover__box-link') || e.target.closest('.logo-carousel-hover__hidden-link')) {
                        return;
                    }
                    e.preventDefault();
                    e.stopPropagation();

                    // Close other open items
                    document.querySelectorAll('.logo-carousel-hover__item.is-open').forEach(openItem => {
                        if (openItem !== item) {
                            openItem.classList.remove('is-open');
                            const openPopup = openItem.querySelector('.logo-carousel-hover__popup');
                            if (openPopup) {
                                openPopup.style.removeProperty('top');
                            }
                        }
                    });

                    if (popup) {
                        const willOpen = !item.classList.contains('is-open');
                        item.classList.toggle('is-open');
                        if (willOpen) {
                            requestAnimationFrame(function() {
                                positionMobilePopupForItem(item, popup);
                            });
                        } else {
                            popup.style.removeProperty('top');
                        }
                    } else if (linkBox) {
                        window.location.href = linkBox.href;
                    } else if (hiddenLink) {
                        window.location.href = hiddenLink.href;
                    }
                });
            });
        
        // Close on overlay click
        if (overlay) {
            overlay.addEventListener('click', function() {
                // Close all
                document.querySelectorAll('.logo-carousel-hover__item.is-open').forEach(openItem => openItem.classList.remove('is-open'));
                overlay.classList.remove('active');
                document.body.style.overflow = '';
            });
        }
        
        // Close on close button click
        document.querySelectorAll('.logo-carousel-hover__popup-close').forEach(button => {
            button.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();
                const item = this.closest('.logo-carousel-hover__item');
                if (item) item.classList.remove('is-open');
                const popup = item ? item.querySelector('.logo-carousel-hover__popup') : null;
                if (popup) {
                    popup.style.removeProperty('top');
                }
                if (overlay) overlay.classList.remove('active');
                document.body.style.overflow = '';
            });
        });
    } else {
        // Desktop behavior - hover to show
        document.querySelectorAll('.logo-carousel-hover__item').forEach((item, index) => {
            const popup = item.querySelector('.logo-carousel-hover__popup');
            if (popup) {
                item.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() {
                    showDesktopPopup(index);
                });
                
                item.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
                    hideDesktopPopup(index);
                });
            }
        });
    }
}

function positionMobilePopupForItem(item, popup) {
    if (!item || !popup || window.innerWidth > 991) return;

    const anchor = item.querySelector('.logo-carousel-hover__image-wrapper') || item;
    const anchorRect = anchor.getBoundingClientRect();
    const viewportPadding = 8;
    const popupHeight = popup.getBoundingClientRect().height || popup.offsetHeight || 0;
    const maxTop = Math.max(viewportPadding, window.innerHeight - popupHeight - viewportPadding);
    const targetTop = anchorRect.top;
    const clampedTop = Math.min(Math.max(targetTop, viewportPadding), maxTop);

    popup.style.top = `${Math.round(clampedTop)}px`;
}

let logoResizeTimer = null;
window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
    if (logoResizeTimer) {
        clearTimeout(logoResizeTimer);
    }
    logoResizeTimer = setTimeout(function() {
        normalizeLogoWidths(document.querySelector('.logo-carousel-hover'));
    }, 150);
});

function normalizeLogoWidths(section) {
    if (!section) return;
    const items = Array.from(section.querySelectorAll('.logo-carousel-hover__item'));
    if (!items.length) return;

    const container = section.querySelector('.logo-carousel-hover__items');
    if (!container) return;

    if (window.innerWidth <= 991) {
        section.style.removeProperty('--logo-equal-width');
        return;
    }

    const sectionStyles = getComputedStyle(section);
    const gapValue = getComputedStyle(container).columnGap || getComputedStyle(container).gap || '0px';
    const gap = parseFloat(gapValue) || 0;
    const count = items.length;
    const targetHeight = parseFloat(sectionStyles.getPropertyValue('--logo-height')) || 50;

    items.forEach(item => {
        const img = item.querySelector('.logo-carousel-hover__image');
        if (!img) return;
        if (!img.complete) {
            img.addEventListener('load', () => normalizeLogoWidths(section), { once: true });
        }
    });

    const containerWidth = container.clientWidth || container.getBoundingClientRect().width;
    const available = containerWidth - gap * (count - 1);
    const equalWidth = Math.max(0, available / count);

    if (equalWidth > 0) {
        section.style.setProperty('--logo-equal-width', `${equalWidth}px`);
    }
}

function showMobilePopup(index) {
    const popup = document.querySelector(`[data-popup-id="${index}"]`);
    const overlay = document.getElementById('popup-overlay');
    
    console.log('showMobilePopup called for index:', index);
    console.log('Popup found:', popup);
    console.log('Overlay found:', overlay);
    
    if (popup && overlay) {
        popup.style.display = 'block';
        popup.style.opacity = '1';
        popup.style.visibility = 'visible';
        overlay.classList.add('active');
        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        console.log('Popup should be visible now');
    } else {
        console.log('Popup or overlay not found');
    }
}

function showDesktopPopup(index) {
    const popup = document.querySelector(`[data-popup-id="${index}"]`);
    if (popup) {
        popup.style.display = 'block';
        popup.style.opacity = '1';
        popup.style.visibility = 'visible';
    }
}

function hideDesktopPopup(index) {
    const popup = document.querySelector(`[data-popup-id="${index}"]`);
    if (popup) {
        popup.style.opacity = '0';
        popup.style.visibility = 'hidden';
    }
}

function closePopup(index) {
    console.log('closePopup called for index:', index);
    const isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 768;
    
    if (isMobile) {
        closeMobilePopup();
    } else {
        hideDesktopPopup(index);
    }
}

function closeMobilePopup() {
    console.log('closeMobilePopup called');
    const popups = document.querySelectorAll('.logo-carousel-hover__popup');
    const overlay = document.getElementById('popup-overlay');
    
    console.log('Found popups:', popups.length);
    console.log('Found overlay:', overlay);
    
    popups.forEach(popup => {
        popup.style.display = 'none';
        popup.style.opacity = '0';
        popup.style.visibility = 'hidden';
    });
    
    if (overlay) {
        overlay.classList.remove('active');
    }
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
    
    console.log('Mobile popup closed');
}

// Handle window resize
window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
    initLogoCarousel();
});
</script>
